title: Disposition of revenues.
bodyText: All moneys collected pursuant to this chapter shall be paid into the state treasury as state realizations, to be kept and accounted for as provided by law.
bodyHtml: [§244D-17]  Disposition of revenues.  All moneys collected pursuant to this chapter shall be paid into the state treasury as state realizations, to be kept and accounted for as provided by law. [L Sp 1984 1st, c 1, pt of §2]
